name: rebalance_inside_band_no_trade
description: Drifted weight is inside the no-trade band, so no order. band_relative=0.25 is the registry example; absolute_band_nav=0.02 and partial_ratio=0.5 are explicit illustrative synthetic values (both PENDING in the monograph, not real parameters).
derivation: equity=10000; AAA mult=1 mark=100, position 10. w_cur=10*1*100/10000=0.10. target=0.11 -> d=0.11-0.10=0.01. threshold=max(band_relative*abs(target), absolute_band_nav)=max(0.25*0.11, 0.02)=max(0.0275, 0.02)=0.0275. abs(d)=0.01 < 0.0275 -> no trade. orders={}.
